about: 𝕭𝕾.Haus is a creative venture studio based in Haggerston, London. We partner with founders and leaders to build and design 0→1 experiences across fashion, art, technology and contemporary culture.

The studio is run by Ben Laing and Sarah Stoutamire (𝕭𝕾), a husband and wife creative duo with over a decade of industry experience, collaborating with both start-up and enterprise-level organisations — from early-stage Web3 platforms to global brands like IKEA, Figma, Decathlon and Zalando.
We combine editorial-focused creative direction with systems and stories to build powerful, immersive brand worlds — and we stay with our partners from first idea to MVP and beyond.
exploring: Alongside client work, the studio explores emerging art, technology and design — spatial computing, AI and blockchain — and how they can shape the next generation of brands and products.
services_intro: We combine editorial focused creative direction with systems and stories to build powerful, immersive brand worlds.

services.title: Strategy
services.description: Helping our clients identify and articulate their distinct perspectives and promises — and earn a valuable place in the lives of their customers.
detail: Every project starts with clarity. We work alongside founders and leadership teams to define what a brand stands for, who it serves and how it should sound — before a single pixel is pushed.
From naming a new venture to designing a new category, our strategy work gives teams a shared story they can build on.

services.title: Design
services.description: Creating the visuals and systems that signal clear and compelling relevance, for internal teams and external audiences, at scale.
detail: We design identities and brand systems that are distinctive on day one and flexible enough to scale — across social, storefront, packaging, product and print.
Our creative sprints get new ideas from concept to tangible design fast, with 3D, illustration and art direction built in.

services.title: Experience
services.description: Deploying creative strategies and activations, that users interact with in the real world, to shape exceptional experiences.
detail: Brands live in the moments people interact with them. We design the campaigns, websites, films and spaces that make those moments land.
From launch campaigns to festival activations and environmental design, we shape experiences people remember.

services.title: Technology
services.description: Building and enhancing tech stacks to elevate digital experiences, up-level productivity, and develop competitive advantages.
detail: We design and build digital products — from marketplaces and Web3 platforms to content-managed websites — and help teams adopt new tools that give them an edge.
That includes AI ideation, mixed reality prototypes and custom brand tools that keep teams creating on-brand at speed.

process.title: Understand
process.text: We begin by challenging assumptions and immersing ourselves in the context. Through research and observation, we uncover the deeper, often unspoken problems.

process.title: Focus
process.text: We synthesise insights and reframe the brief with strategic clarity. This ensures we’re solving the right problem — not just responding to a request.

process.title: Explore
process.text: We explore multiple directions, pressure-test ideas, and refine collaboratively. The goal is to push creative boundaries while staying grounded in purpose.

process.title: Refine
process.text: We execute with precision and intent, translating strategy into tangible outcomes. Every detail is considered to ensure the work lands with lasting impact.
